set.body: Owner: Intaglio core axis/break policy. Consumer reproduction lead: PLS Neuro bd-01M1XYE51VCHZRQS0NR3YQBBD4, values just inside +/-0.5 with pretty targets 2/3 can leave only zero. Reproduce through public Breaks and ordinary plot APIs before editing. Acceptance: finite nondegenerate narrow ranges retain at least two informative within-domain ticks when representable; ordinary 1/2/5 grids and typed non-progress/error behavior remain; no scientific data rounding, fixture-specific values, or out-of-range tick weakening. Verify JVM/JS scale and fuzz suites, public SVG figures and exact consumer candidate evidence. Marker clipping/dock sizing are separate questions; no generic rendering defect inferred from historical screenshots alone.
set.title: Keep sparse pretty axes informative near rounded extrema
